confirmed_uv_transform.interpretation: SI_Texture2D image-space UV scale and offset
confirmed_uv_transform.source_evidence: Public dotXSI exporter source writes SI_Texture2D U/V scale followed by U/V offset; BZ2 corpus values at +6 match defaults and authored placement behavior.

projection_creation_type_frontier.corrected_interpretation: strong candidate for Softimage projection creation/operator type; not the readable dotXSI SI_Texture2D.mappingType field
projection_creation_type_frontier.why_mapping_type_is_rejected: Public dotXSI exporter source uses mappingType=3 for explicit UVs, while BZ2 code-400 records with +24=3 occur on class-4 meshes whose baked polygon UVs are all zero and therefore still require projected coordinates.

5: walker body and mechanical class-4 parts

relation_aware_code400_corpus.note: Generic TXMP records outside model-local relation code 400 also contain higher values, including 7 and 8, but those values do not occur in this extracted code-400 projection set.

code_2.evidence: ISDF-walker-grid1 is a recovered 13x13 support/floor grid whose vertices lie on XZ at Y=0; its model-local TXMP uses +24=2. Autodesk SDK examples use siTxtPlanarXZ on a grid. The original archived walker render and matching recovered camera now provide pixel-level validation ground truth.

code_4.status: official numeric anchor plus corpus correlation
code_4.evidence: Autodesk SDK source example passes numeric 4.0 to CreateProjection and comments it as siTxtSpherical; BZ2 +24=4 occurs on revolved/rounded and pilot body geometry.

code_5.status: strong exclusive structural/corpus corroboration; exact authoritative enum line still pending
code_5.evidence: Every relation-code-400 +24=5 edge has TXMP +78=1 (254/254), while every code-400 edge of types 1,2,3,4 has +78=0. Across the 664-record generic archival TXMP set the same exclusivity holds for all 117 +24=5 records. This identifies code 5 as a distinct seam/wrap-bearing projection class and is consistent with cylindrical mapping without assigning semantics to +78 itself.

4.status: official numeric anchor plus corpus correlation

auxiliary_projection_type_fields.production_policy: Preserve +76 and +78 as raw u16 fields only. Their exact Softimage semantic names are unresolved and they must not yet be labeled as wrap, repeat, alternate or swap flags.
